camera.description: Public RGB-D camera name; all points refer to this one view.

points_uv.description: Independent positive point queries on one image. Prefer 3–5 separated interior points; these points are not a joint prompt for one mask.

items.description: One independent positive point [u,v], in integer source-image pixels; OpenCV top-left coordinates.

max_candidates.description: Per-point mask budget: at most this many distinct masks for each queried point separately, an integer 1-3; omitted means 3. It is not a total across the call. Every point's leading mask is admitted before any point's second, so this bounds how many alternatives one point may keep, never which points get an answer. A call delivers at most 12 distinct masks and 5 enlarged crops overall, and each point reports what it lost to its own budget and to that shared cap separately.

step.description: Optional saved observation step in the current round. Omit or null for the current image; historical targets remain historical.
